name: Should I choose custom cabinets or stock cabinets for a rental property?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose custom cabinets or stock cabinets for a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most rental properties, stock or semi-custom cabinets are generally a more cost-effective and practical choice than custom cabinets. Stock cabinets offer good durability, quicker availability, and a wide range of styles suitable for rental appeal. Custom cabinets, while offering tailored designs and superior craftsmanship, often come with a higher price tag and longer lead times, which might not align with the ROI goals for a rental. Prioritize functional and durable options that blend well with various tenant preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stock or semi-custom cabinets are usually better for rental properties due to cost-effectiveness, durability, and quicker availability compared to expensive custom options.
